user.title: Fantasy Premier League
user.description: Enter your FPL manager ID. You can find it in the URL when you open the Points tab on fantasy.premierleague.com: `/entry/'{manager_id}'/event/1`.

data_description.manager_id: The numeric ID of the FPL team to track. Public data only - no login required.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Fantasy Premier League API.
error.manager_not_found: No FPL team exists with that manager ID.

abort.already_configured: This manager ID is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often to poll the FPL API, in minutes. Scores update roughly every minute during matches, but the API is unofficial - be considerate.
